item.title: I Went to the Woods: Risk Assessment
item.description: I look behind me every so often to watch the white wake part into a liquid wedge behind me. I can clearly read 150 on the cowling. Everything is good. I don’t really know what I’m looking for. Maybe I like the uniformity of the path I’m cutting in the water. Maybe I’m looking for smoke. Either way, it occurred to me on the last run out to the cabin that if I did see smoke, I’d be in trouble. That’s what the raft is for, but the raft is tightly secured to the hard top of my Hewescraft. The raft was a means to get to shore. I’d load it up with my chainsaw, ax and other equipment until the build was far enough along for me to drop in building supplies.
